Some athletes who have poor diets and athletes such as wres-
tlers, jockeys, figure skaters, gymnasts, or rowers who consume 
low-calorie diets for long periods of time may be prone to defi-
ciencies. A B-complex vitamin supplement to meet the RDA 
may be appropriate. However, there is no evidence that supple-
menting the well-nourished athlete with more B vitamins in-
creases performance.
